en: A black‑and‑white postcard showing a large military review or parade held in an open park or parade ground, surrounded by rows of soldiers and spectators. The scene is framed by leafless trees and townhouses in the background. Massed troops form large rectangular and circular formations around an open central area where officers and standard‑bearers are assembled. The postcard includes a printed French caption at the top describing the event in Colmar on 22 November 1918.
